tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: ye shes rab 'bar las: bskyed rdzogs chung ngu'i dang po las kyi drag po bzlog pa dang 'brel ba'i phrin las bzhugs so:

e ma nyon cig rigs kyi bu: drag po padma'i sgrub pa la: dben pa'i gnas su mtshams bcad cing: dkyil 'khor sgo gru rgyan rnams rdzogs: dbus su gru gsum bsnol ma bya: sgrub rten bhandha mtshan ldan dang: zur mang shel dang me long dang: bum pa mtshan ldan mgul chings dmar: ma nyams rdo rje dril bu dang: thod pa ltag sprod la sogs 'chang: sgrub gtor gru gsum bsnol ba'i thog: dpal gtor zur gsum brjid ldan bsham: dang po bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: nga ni dbang drag padma khro bo'i sku: sku las khro chung mtshon cha'i thog ser 'phro: gsang sngags sgrub la blta bar mi dbang kun: byer cig dengs shig rang rang gnas su dengs: hūm̐ hrī: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: sumbha= gnyis pa lta bas mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bdag ni dbang drag padma he ru ka: phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud lhar gyur pa'i: phyi rol mtshon cha me ri sdig pa'i gur: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor 'gyur med lhun gyis grub: badzra rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūm̐: gsum pa brda sgo phye dang brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: bskal pa sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i yi dam lha: gu ru drag po deng 'dir mjal phyag 'tshal: a ti pū ho: byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bdag gis gsol ba btab pa'i yi dam lha: 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal mgon o rgyan rje: padma drag po'i rnam par skur bzhengs la: deng 'dir bdag la byin chen dbab tu gsol: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi nang mchod rdzas lha mi'i 'dod yon rdzas: bsangs sbyangs kun bzang sprin gyi phung por gyur: arghaṃ sogs shabda pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: dbyings kyi bhandhar bcud kyi ra sā yan: rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba'i bcud du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: hūm̐: snod kyi thod par rakta'i ba gam 'khrigs:

gīrti dmar mos gsang ba'i byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥthā: hūm̐: khor yug snod du gtor chen ri ltar spungs: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ngo bor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: hūm̐: phyi nang snod bcud bdag gzhan stong par sbyang: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las tshad med snying rje'i mdangs: dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: shes rig ngo bo hūm̐ yig dmar por bzhengs: badzra tsitta hūm̐: hūm̐: skyed byed rgyu yi yi ge hūm̐ dmar las: e 'phros chos 'byung nam mkha'i rang bzhin las: yaṃ 'phros 'byung ba rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng: baṃ 'phros ye shes rakta'i rgya mtshor 'khyil: laṃ 'phros rin chen sa gzhi snyoms par brdal: bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe dzñā na tsakra maṇḍa la bhrūm̐: bhrūm̐ las skam rlon thod pa'i gzhal yas su: 'od dang 'od zer tshang khang 'khrigs pa las: ye shes drag po me ris bskor ba'i dbus: gsang sgrub ltar du bskyed cing: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gzugs sku padma 'od 'bar skad cig la: rngam brjid khros pa'i hūm̐ sgra phyogs bcur sgrog: sprul pa yang sprul dpag yas 'jigs tshul ston: che mchog dmar nag me yi phreng ba can: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs la byon: dza: chos kyi dbyings las sgyu mar skur bzhengs pa: dug gsum 'bar ba'i khro gtum 'jigs gzugs can: dregs pa sde brgyad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol:

mdze nad gnyan lhog 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: smyo 'bog brgyal nad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: mtha' yi dmag dpung 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: mi nad phyugs nad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: nad mug mtshon 'khrugs 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐: gru gsum dmar nag dregs pa'i gdan khri la: drag po dgyes par dgongs la bzhugs su gsol: phyag 'tshal ba niḥ na mo: skye 'gag 'gyur med drag po'i sku: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol: yid bzhin dngos grub char 'beb pa'i: padma drag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mchod 'bul ni: hūm̐: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil: rigs lnga yab yum bdud rtsi char ltar 'beb: ye shes bdud rtsi gnyis med mnyam sbyor ba: padma drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta la khā hi: hūm̐: rten 'brel bcu gnyis rakta'i rba rlabs 'khrug: gu hya mū la rakta'i ba gam 'khrigs: gīrti'i rakta skar ltar 'khrugs pa 'di: padma drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā rakta la khā hi: gtor ma 'bul ba ni: srid gsum ye nas gtor gzhong du: snod bcud thams cad gtor mar sbyar: 'khor 'das yongs sgrol mchod pa'i tshogs: dbang drag 'bar ba khyod la 'bul: stong gsum stong gi gtor gzhong du: ri rab 'bar ba'i dpal bshos btsug: skye 'gro sems can grangs las 'das: dbang drag 'bar ba khyod la 'bul: bhandha 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du: dgra bgegs sha khrag thod tshil spungs: zhag dang rlangs pa chi li li: dbang drag 'bar ba khyod la 'bul: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sil snyan rol mo dang: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: dbang drag 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang: ma hā bā linta la khā hi: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bde chen rang bzhin khros pa'i dkyil 'khor nas:

padma drag po dmar nag 'bar ba'i sku: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad: gtum drag 'jigs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar: sde brgyad zil gyis gnon cing gzir bar byed: g.yon pa'i sdig pas lha srin snying khrag 'jib: dmar nag khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dregs pa 'dul mdzad dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: log 'dren 'dul mdzad dpal gyi chas rnams rdzogs: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs klu dang dgra bgegs 'dul: dbang drag 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag ni drag po sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas: khyod kyi thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i tshe: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la bab: rgyal bsen 'gong po 'dul ba'i dus la bab: lha srin sde brgyad bzlog pa'i dus la bab: nad mug mtshon 'khrugs bzlog pa'i dus la bab: mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i dus la bab: bdag gi bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: padma drag po'i dkyil 'khor du tshogs kyi yo byad thams cad bshams nas: bsang sbyang bya ba ni: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: yi ge raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum 'phros: tshogs kyi dngos po bsreg cing bkrus: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: slar yang snying po 'bru gsum 'phros: 'dod yon zag med bdud rtsis gang: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: rgyu yi bcud chen sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: ye shes rigs lnga'i bdud rtsi bcud du 'khyil: 'dod yon tshogs dang dbyer med bde ba che: lha rnams dgyes mdzad sngags kyi 'dod yon 'khrigs: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: spyan 'dren pa niḥ hrī: rje btsun padma drag po rtsal: rdo rje phag mo gtso 'khor dang: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mchod pa ni: hrī: bla ma drag po rdo rje phag mo dang: rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la tshogs mchod 'bul: bdag gis ma rig thugs dang ci 'gal ba:

'dod yon tshogs mchod 'bul bas bskang zhing bshags: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra satwa sa ma ya: bsgral las ni: bden tshig gis bla srog bkug la: hūm̐: che mchog padma drag po'i sku: rngams drag gtum pa'i rang bzhin las: yaksha me dbal skar ltar 'khrugs: las kyi pho nyas stong gsum khengs: g.yas pas rdo rje phur pa 'dril: g.yon pas lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la bab: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: bskang ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: bstan dgra bsgral pa'i bam gyi tshogs: sha khrag dmar gyi don snying 'di: drag po dgyes pa bskang ba'i phyir: zhal du bstab po kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta ba su ta go ro tsa na la khā hi: lhag ma ni: dang po phud kyis dkyil 'khor lha rnams mchod: bar du tshogs kyis 'dus pa rgya mtsho bskang: tha ma lhag la dbang ba 'dir gshegs shig: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong zhing sgrub pa'i grogs: dbang phyug ging dang laṅka 'bar ma yis: bka' yi pha 'bab lhag ma'i longs spyod bzhes: ci bcol phrin las sgrub la ma g.yel zhig: sa ma ya utstshiṣṭa ba linta khā hi khā hi: chad mdo ni: hūm̐: bskal pa sngon tshe bar dang tha ma la: kun bzang snang mtha' padma thod phreng gis: bka' gsang gter du sbas dang bton pa'i tshe: bka' srung so sos khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: phrin las sgrubs shig bka' yi srung ma rnams: bka' dang dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya: da lta snyigs ma'i sems can 'dul ba'i dus: slob dpon chen po padma thod phreng rtsal: rdzogs chen rnal 'byor klong gsal snying po la: skad cig 'bral ba med par byin brlabs nas: zhal mjal dbang bskur snyan brgyud bstan pa'i tshe: bka' srung so sos khas blangs dam bcas bzhin: phrin las sgrubs shig bka' yi srung ma'i tshogs: bka' dang dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya: brtan skyong ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon padma yis: rgya bal bod yul gnas rnams su: lha 'drer ma lus dam la btags:

dam la ma 'dus gang yang med: lha 'dres bka' las mi 'da' 'tshal: bka' las ma 'da' dam la 'dus: gang bcol sgrubs shig sa ma ya: mnan pa ni: hūm̐: dug lnga 'dus pa'i lha 'dre mnan: steng du drag po'i bro brdungs pas: lha 'dre bdag tu 'dzin pa bcom: rang grol klong du rgyas 'debs so: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ lam st+wam bha ya mā ra ya nan: bkra shis ni: hrī: zhi ba'i dbang phyug padma thod phreng rtsal: drag po'i che btsan che mchog he ru ka: dbyings phyug phag mo mkha' 'gro'i bran dang bcas: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha yi bkra shis shog: hrī: mkha' mnyam 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i gzhi: skye dgus bstod tshe me tog char 'beb pa: rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa'i bkra shis gang: bkra shis des kyang rtag tu bde legs shog: bsnyen bsgrubs dge bas mkha' mnyam skye 'gro yi: 'jigs pa brgyad zhi 'byor pa mang rgyas shing: khams gsum dbang 'du dgra bgegs ming med pas: 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog: bsngo ba ni: hrī: bskyed rdzogs 'bras bus legs pa'i dge ba gang: dmigs med mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro la bsngo: byang chub snying po'i sa bon gong 'phel nas: ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig: smon lam ni: hrī: dmigs med 'gro la bsngos pa'i sa bon gang: bskyed dang rdzogs pa chen po'i smin grol gyis: phyam gcig chos dbyings klong du skyel ba yi: nus pas dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog: bsdu rim ni: snang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs kun: rang grol stong pa'i chos dbyings klong du a: gang shar padma drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'gro ba'i dpal du lam khyer lhang nger gsal: rang byung dkyil 'khor gang shar lha tshogs la: tshogs drug mchod 'bul lha mo'i mchod 'bul gyis: bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i dpal la rol: lam khyer drag po'i rnam rol ma yengs par: gzhom gzhig mi mnga' padma drag po bzhin:

kun gyi che btsan 'grub pa e ma ho: de ltar drag po'i bskyed rdzogs yid bzhin snying: phyi rabs rjes 'jug don du dbab pa 'di: gnam chen dal du mkha' 'gros bdag tu 'dzin: mkha' 'gro'i gces nor bu dang 'phrad pa 'byung: zungs shig drag po gsum dang srog bdag gsum: 'gro ba'i zug rngu tsha ba'i dus der spyod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zhes bde chen gnam chen brag dkar zla gam dbang gi dal nas ye shes mkha' 'gros spyan drangs pa ste/ yid kyi grogs po padma mkha' spyod kyis bskul phyir bde klong rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa klong gsal snying pos rang bzhin lha'i gzhal med khang du dag par phab pa'o// //
